title: Surreal Cinema Vortex
description: A woman in a red jacket stands on a spiral staircase in an abandoned, flooded movie theater, holding a film reel. A massive swirling vortex of colorful film reels, floating paintings, running horses, and fragmented memories spirals upward into a cosmic sky above her.
prompt: A woman in a red jacket stands on a metal spiral staircase inside a dilapidated old movie theater with flooded floors and broken seats. She holds a film reel while looking up at a massive swirling colorful vortex of floating film reels, classical paintings, running white horses, and fragmented memories that spirals into a cosmic starry sky, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, cinematic lighting
